svg.title: Daywise system architecture
svg.desc: Photon messages, Google Calendar and optional Perceptron/location inputs feed persistent state and contextual features. A bounded language-model coordinator uses LinUCB-ranked options. A separate deterministic conflict planner produces approval proposals. Conditional Calendar updates require approval. Session feedback is saved in Supabase and updates weighted reward estimates.

g.text: Message ingestion → context/state → model + scheduling rules → approved execution → feedback update
The bot receives text and photos.
Calendar returns events and busy times.
Location can identify a stable place.
The runtime keeps session and decision state.
Quiet hours and cooldowns gate prompts.
The LLM receives facts and ranked options.
Its response must match an action schema.
Context encodes place, setup and duration.
Six flags identify missing input values.
Two fitted heads predict productivity and mood.
New linked check-ins update reward estimates.
Time of day and subject are excluded.
Only eligible bot-created events can move.
The planner preserves duration and day.
It chooses the smallest time shift.
Invited and recurring events stay fixed.
A private expiring link shows the proposal.
Approval rechecks the event and destination.
A conditional PATCH applies the approved edit.
The user gives three ratings from 1 to 5.
Other observations get weight 1 in updates.
Each chat has a private dashboard.
